pages.text: IF runs its code block only when its expression is true.$(br2)The expression must give a BOOLEAN and ends with $(1);$(). A code block follows. The last END of the condition is followed by an IF block.
There is no ELSE IF. Put another IF inside the ELSE code block instead.
Craft a structural base and wheat seeds, or turn an ELSE block into an IF block.
$(1)IF candidate \ divisor = 0 ;$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN prime FALSE ;$(br)END IF$()
